nl: Three tools/idle.py processes run with the arguments svc-alpha-1, svc-beta-1, svc-gamma-1. Stop only the one started with svc-alpha-1; the other two must keep running.

setup.description: Three tools/idle.py processes run with the arguments svc-alpha-1, svc-beta-1, svc-gamma-1.
setup.bash:
setsid python3 tools/idle.py svc-alpha-1 > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
setsid python3 tools/idle.py svc-beta-1 > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
setsid python3 tools/idle.py svc-gamma-1 > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
sleep 0.5
setup.pwsh:
$py = if ($IsWindows) { 'python' } else { 'python3' }
$p = Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/idle.py','svc-alpha-1' -PassThru
$p = Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/idle.py','svc-beta-1' -PassThru
$p = Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/idle.py','svc-gamma-1' -PassThru
Start-Sleep -Seconds 1

teardown.bash:
pkill -f -- 'idle.py svc-alpha-1' || true
pkill -f -- 'idle.py svc-beta-1' || true
pkill -f -- 'idle.py svc-gamma-1' || true
teardown.pwsh:
Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*idle.py svc-alpha-1*' } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*idle.py svc-beta-1*' } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*idle.py svc-gamma-1*' } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
